name: text-animate
title: Text Animate
description: Text primitive that reveals a heading by line, word or letter, with presets for fading, blurring, sliding and scaling.

meta.interaction: When the text scrolls into view its pieces appear one after another in a quick ripple, each letter or word fading, unblurring, sliding or scaling into place depending on the preset chosen.

props.name: className
props.description: The class name to be applied to the component

props.name: segmentClassName
props.description: The class name to be applied to each segment

props.name: delay
props.description: The delay before the animation starts

props.name: variants
props.description: Custom motion variants for the animation

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Whether to start animation when component enters viewport
